Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is keen to move forward but procurement has flagged a few constraints that will affect pricing/discount eligibility. Quick summary of their asks: 

- Our AP system requires a "Remittance ID" (RMID) on each invoice line so payments auto-apply to PO-ledger entries.
- We need invoices consolidated to a weekly statement per legal entity (we have 3 subsidiaries).
- Corporate policy prefers net60 for new vendor contracts; earlier terms need special approval.
- For any advanced-commitment discounts, Procurement wants the PO to include a specific "commitment code" field and be human-readable for ERP mapping.

Can Redwood support RMID as a bespoke invoice field (not just in PDF notes) and will doing net60 automatically disqualify us from greater discount bands? Also attaching our PO template so you can see the required headers (PO_template.xlsx).

If you can share a sample invoice showing RMID and how ledger tags would appear, that will speed things up on our side.

Appreciate it — Julia

Hi Julia — good to hear and thanks for the template. Short answers up front: yes, we can persist an RMID as structured invoice metadata and yes, we can accommodate weekly consolidated statements. Net60 does affect the standard discount bands but we have middle-ground options. Details below.

Options we typically offer (to align with procurement constraints):

1) Standard terms: Net30 — 5% volume discount for annual commit (MSA + one PO per entity).
2) Net60 friendly: Net60 — 2% volume discount for annual commit (no MSA advance-payment requirement).
3) Committed prepay: Prepaid/advanced commitment for 10% discount (requires signed MSA and prepay invoice; allows us to map RMID and provide consolidated weekly posting).

Operational notes:
- RMID: we can add a discrete invoice field called "RMID" that is included in the E-invoice/EDI payload and rendered on the PDF. That field will be available to your ERP as a searchable tag.
- PO fields: please ensure the PO includes: PO number, legal entity code, RMID (or allowance to provide RMID in invoice metadata), and commitment code. I attached a short PO field matrix that lists the exact header names we can map. (po_field_matrix.csv)
- Consolidation: we can produce a weekly consolidated statement per legal entity and also deliver per-PO line items in the supporting CSV for AP reconciliation.
- E-invoicing: we support Ariba PunchOut/Invoice and can send an EDI 810 if your ERP requires it; otherwise PDF + CSV is common.

I've attached the current discount schedule for reference (discount_schedule_v2.pdf). If Procurement requires net60 but also needs a higher discount, we can offer a blended solution: a 3% annual-commit discount for net60 if Nimbus signs a 12-month minimum and allows Redwood to issue a monthly pre-billed credit note for reconciliation. That lets us price predictably while giving Nimbus the cashflow you need.

Sample next steps:
- I can send a redlined MSA for the prepay/advanced-discount option (DocuSign).
- We can produce a dummy invoice showing RMID and consolidated weekly statement by EOD tomorrow for your AP team to validate.

Which path should I prepare materials for?

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: discount_schedule_v2.pdf, po_field_matrix.csv
